meta.name: product-manager-toolkit
meta.description: Comprehensive toolkit for product managers including RICE prioritization, customer interview analysis, PRD templates, discovery frameworks, and go-to-market strategies. Use for feature prioritization, user research synthesis, requirement documentation, and product strategy development.

copy.tagline: 用框架和模板系统化推进产品管理工作
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你是产品经理，需要结构化工具来管理需求、分析和策略。
copy.tagline_en: Systematize product management with frameworks and templates
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are a product manager needing structured tools for requirements, analysis, and strategy.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude可以帮你给功能做RICE优先级排序、分析客户访谈记录、按模板写PRD，并运用产品发现框架推进需求。
howto.when: 当你提出功能排序、客户访谈分析、PRD编写等产品管理需求时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这几个功能按RICE打分排序
分析这份客户访谈记录，提取痛点和需求
say.note: Claude会用访谈分析脚本提取洞察

say.text: 用标准PRD模板生成产品需求文档
say.note: Claude会套用模板并填充内容

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can help you prioritize features using RICE, analyze customer interview transcripts, write PRDs from templates, and apply product discovery frameworks.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for feature prioritization, customer interview analysis, PRD writing, or other product management tasks.

say_en.text: Score these features with RICE for me
say_en.note: Claude runs the RICE prioritizer script

say_en.text: Analyze this interview transcript for pain points and needs
say_en.note: Claude extracts insights using the analyzer

say_en.text: Generate a PRD using the standard template
say_en.note: Claude fills the template and outputs a draft
